_comment: OPT-IN live GAM forecast. Rename to gam.json inside your MCP_CONFIG_DIR to activate; it takes precedence over forecast.json. The node asks GAM ForecastService for every family x period at boot and every 30 minutes with prospective line items that are never saved, and answers buyers from that snapshot with synthetic:false. The service account must be a user of the GAM network with a role that can read inventory and run forecasts. Keep the key outside the repo; GAM_SA_KEY_PATH overrides service_account_key_path. Families missing here return NOT_FOUND on get_forecast.
